replacements.reason: Decode the immutable PowerPC color-animation command word with its original six-bit opcode and 26-bit timer layout on native little-endian i686.
Return the following runtime-owned ColorOverlay pointers, counters, colors, and flags to native host storage immediately after the immutable command-word overlay.
Decode the original big-endian PowerPC fighter/item command byte stream with its declared scalar and bitfield meanings on the native little-endian i686 compiler.

Keep startup-materialized native subroutine and goto pointers in host byte order while the surrounding immutable command words retain the original big-endian scalar layout. GCC applies scalar_storage_order to these pointer-only overlays and otherwise byte-swaps a valid native pointer before Command_05 or Command_07 follows it.

Decode the two byte-aligned PowerPC halfwords as big-endian u16 scalars. GCC's reverse scalar storage order selects the correct half of a u32 bitfield container but otherwise reads each 16-bit field's bytes in host order (for example source GFX 0x0407 becomes 0x0704).
Decode byte-aligned hitbox size and offsets as signed or unsigned big-endian halfword scalars instead of host-byte-order slices of a 32-bit bitfield container.
Decode the byte-aligned sound command halfword and bytes directly from the immutable big-endian command stream.
Decode byte-aligned stage-SFX halfwords and bytes as big-endian scalar fields rather than host-byte-order slices of a u32 bitfield container.
Return subsequent runtime-owned CommandInfo floats, counters, and native pointers to the host scalar layout after the packed asset command overlay definitions.
